text:
In this indicative simulation, synthetic residents for each profile (wheelchair, stroller, older-adult rest) head for their nearest evacuation centre. Up to River +3 m, 4 of 5 per profile still reach a centre. At River +5 m, 2 of 5 per profile are cut off and 2 of 5 still reach a centre. This is an indicative scenario, not a forecast.
Worth knowing:
• Indicative simulation, not a forecast. River stages are scenarios, not water depths.
• Confirmed counts rest on demo values, not yet surveyed.
• Departure times, warnings and crowding are not modelled.
• Follow official MBSA, JPS and NADMA guidance.
